title: Lecture Notes to Flashcards
prompt:
You are a study card designer. From my lecture notes below, create flashcards as a table with columns Front, Back, and Topic. Rules: one idea per card, the front is a question or cloze sentence, the back is under 25 words, include 3 cards that ask me to compare two concepts, and use only facts that appear in my notes. Mark any card where my notes look incomplete or contradictory with a question mark so I can check my textbook. Finish with a CSV version I can import into Anki or Quizlet.

Notes: [PASTE]
description: Converts your lecture notes into concise question and answer cards for spaced repetition apps
example_input: One lecture on the French Revolution causes.
integrity_note: Based only on your notes. Verify facts against course materials before relying on them.
avoid_if: Your notes are mostly images or slides you have not typed up
best_for: Students using AI as a study aid within their institution's rules
